criteria.proof: Real SQLite and HTTP; all four profiles, rights, unknown values and reports.
SQLite trigger aborts the actual UPDATE; HTTP 500, no ok:true, previous persisted values survive.
Mutation removes the actual UPDATE in a disposable archive; strict expected-data assertion must fail.
Independent process opens real SQLite; full browser reload verifies all persisted fixture values.
Real legacy return functions and routes; conflicts, partial rights, storage errors and source-slice tests retained.
Real login, navigation, case/report reload, actual renderer, health UI edit and independent SQLite confirmation after restore.

Pinned Node 22.23.2/24.18.0 on Ubuntu, fresh install, all portable tests, browser restore and expected failing mutation; both unchanged sips golden tests required in a separate macOS job. The partitions cover every test once per applicable platform; skips remain failures.

Real backup/restore CLIs, SQLite integrity, cases/reports/users/rights, nine files, HTML/templates and source isolation. Stable device identification on BSD/GNU stat; partial failed command output is discarded and mode/device values must be numeric.
Corrupt snapshot fails before target mutation; dry-run also preserves target.
Missing/wrong key and premature release refused; quarantine and protected DB state retained; correct pair rekeyed, released and restarted.
Actual application regenerates a stored synthetic report before and after restore with a fixed PDF timestamp; SHA-256 equality and one-page parsing.

knownDeviations.observed: The legacy stammdaten PATCH endpoint has no revision precondition for concurrent edits of the same field.
knownDeviations.acceptanceImpact: Recorded baseline behavior, not an accepted new concurrency contract.
